scope.independence: Polymarket owns market identity, books, fees, wallet, orders, positions, risk, PnL, settlement, stop, and recovery. Binance has no credential, account, order, balance, position, capital, PnL, risk, or execution role.
scope.optional_binance_input: Credential-free public BTC spot and futures observations may already be present in the hash-bound probability evidence. They may preserve, reduce, or veto a Polymarket action only.

action_paths.name: settlement_directional
action_paths.rule: At most one delayed Polymarket FOK directional entry per condition, held to official settlement unless a separately proven owned-only safety close is required.

action_paths.name: intrawindow_owned_reprice
action_paths.rule: A delayed Polymarket FOK entry may be sold only from an exact parent-bound bot-owned lot using delayed displayed bids and exact fees. Missing or uncertain close state receives no proceeds credit.

action_paths.name: complement_lock
action_paths.rule: A complement FOK purchase is eligible only when exact combined owned shares guarantee nonnegative worst-case payout after all costs, fees, latency, depth stress, and quantity mismatch.

risk.global: No profile may bypass source health, exact costs, delayed depth, ownership, reconciliation, unknown-state, daily-loss, drawdown, cooldown, or promotion gates.

execution_lifecycle.entry_rule: Freeze the FOK limit, quantity, fee bound, and maximum loss from the latest healthy paired Polymarket creation books received at or before the decision. Apply that immutable intent to the first same-segment book observed at or after the submission-latency target.
execution_lifecycle.entry_unknown_rule: A missing, invalid, cross-segment, or unprovable post-submit state is charged the full frozen maximum entry loss and blocks the condition.
execution_lifecycle.intrawindow_exit_trigger: For an exact parent-bound owned lot, plan a FOK sell from a causal creation book only when fee-bounded minimum executable proceeds exceed the model lower-confidence settlement value. Apply the fixed close intent to a separate delayed same-segment book.
execution_lifecycle.complement_trigger: Plan an exact-quantity complement FOK only when the creation-book limit plus the maximum fee bound guarantees nonnegative combined payout after the original entry cost. Apply the fixed complement intent to a separate delayed same-segment book.
execution_lifecycle.terminal_fallback: If no proven owned close or safe complement fills, value the exact owned lot at the official Polymarket settlement outcome.

selection.primary: Maximize the worst-scenario daily-block lower-95 mean event utility.
selection.secondary: Then prefer higher primary net PnL, lower drawdown, a higher edge floor, and the simpler action path.
